title: Words can be underlined, and the underline follows them
goal: A person (or an agent) building a web page or a link can underline words from the text controls, the way every design tool and word processor can; today the only way is a drawn line that stays the old length when the words change.
notes: Found by scenario 4 of claude-can-make-and-edit-pictures-and-videos-in (2026-10-19): a fresh agent session rebuilding GOV.UK links drew 1 pt lines under each title and said in its summary they will not resize with the words (transcript queue/audits/2026-10-19-agent-skill-transcript.md, scenario 4). TextContent has no decoration today (Sources/PhotonzCore/Layer.swift); TextTreatment would need it for styles; SVGExporter text-decoration. Command U on a picture: check Photoshop parity (UX-PATTERNS §7) before taking it. Agent side: add_text/set_layer/add_style get an underline flag once the app has it.
acceptance: The text controls offer Underline (and Strikethrough beside it), with the usual Command U on a picture
An underline follows the words: retyping them, restyling them or a text style changing redraws it at the new width, in every line of a wrapped block
Underlined words export as underlined text in SVG and draw the same in PNG and on a video
A text style can carry underline, so a Link style is underlined wherever it is worn
